career_ladder.note: Clerical cadres in Punjab Government departments, Directorates, and the Punjab Civil Secretariat are governed by the Punjab Civil Services (General and Common Conditions of Service) Rules, 1994 and respective departmental ministerial service rules. Progression from Clerk to Senior Assistant requires 5 years regular service and passing the statutory Senior Assistant departmental examination. Senior Assistants can advance into gazetted administrative cadres including Superintendent and Under Secretary in the Secretariat.

exam_scheme.note: Selection process consists of three distinct stages: Stage 1 (Objective OMR Written Examination comprising Part A qualifying Punjabi and Part B merit paper), Stage 2 (Mandatory Computer Typing Test in Punjabi Raavi font and English at 30 wpm), and Stage 3 (Counselling & Document Verification). Final merit is compiled strictly on marks secured in Part B of the written test among candidates who qualify Part A and both typing tests.

stages.source_label: PSSSB Official Syllabus & Scheme of Examination for Clerk (Advt. No. 15/2022)

papers.paper_name: Part A (Mandatory Qualifying Punjabi Language Paper equivalent to Matriculation standard)
papers.negative_marking: No negative marking (1 mark per correct answer)

papers.paper_name: Part B (General Knowledge 30 Qs, Mental Ability 20 Qs, Basic Arithmetic 15 Qs, English 15 Qs, Punjabi 10 Qs, Computer & ICT Literacy 10 Qs)
papers.negative_marking: -0.25 marks deducted per incorrect answer (1 mark per correct answer)
papers.qualifying_threshold: 40% minimum aggregate passing mark (35% for SC/ST)

financial_package.note: Salaries for Clerks across Punjab Civil Secretariat, Heads of Departments, and district administrations are governed by the Punjab Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2021 notified by the Department of Finance, Government of Punjab. Entry basic pay is ₹19,900 under Punjab Pay Matrix Level 2. In terms of Department of Finance policy instructions (Letters No. 7/204/2012-4FP1/60 dated 15.01.2015 and No. 7/42/2020-5FP1/741-746 dated 17.07.2020), newly recruited personnel receive fixed minimum basic pay without allowances during the initial 3-year probation period, after which regular allowances (DA, HRA, secretariat allowance, medical allowance) are admissible in full.
financial_package.pay_level: Punjab Pay Matrix Level 2 (Entry Basic ₹19,900; Scale ₹19,900 - ₹63,200)
financial_package.pay_source_label: PSSSB Advt. No. 15/2022 & Punjab Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules 2021, Department of Finance, Government of Punjab
financial_package.estimate_note: Post-probation gross salary is computed from Punjab Pay Matrix Level 2 entry basic ₹19,900 + 58% DA (₹11,542) + Punjab HRA (ranging from 8% in sub-divisional towns to 16% in SAS Nagar/Mohali and Chandigarh Secretariat postings: ₹1,592 to ₹3,184) + fixed medical allowance (₹1,000) + secretariat/clerical allowance. Net in-hand estimate accounts for statutory deductions including 10% NPS contribution (Basic + DA = ₹3,144), Punjab Development Tax (₹200/month), and GIS (₹120). Newly appointed clerks draw fixed basic ₹19,900 during initial probation as per state policy.
official_perks: Government staff residential quarters allotment in Punjab Government housing estates or district pools (subject to availability)
Fixed monthly medical allowance under Punjab Medical Attendance Rules
Contributory pension coverage under National Pension System (NPS) with 14% matching employer contribution by Government of Punjab
Group Insurance Scheme (GIS) cover and retirement gratuity benefits
Special Secretariat Pay / Allowance for personnel posted in Punjab Civil Secretariat, Chandigarh
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and standard state civil service leave entitlements
